correctness.rationale: The bilinear quandle equation is u=alpha(u) beta(u) in ordinary cyclic group algebra. For char !=p Fourier coefficients satisfy c_i=c_-i c_(2i); nonzero support is H=<−1,2> invariant and each active orbit is t^N=1; Frobenius descent closes cycles by t^(q^d−sigma 2^e)=1, yielding 1+g choices per orbit cycle plus c_0=0 or 1. For char=p the augmentation-zero solution is zero by nilpotence; truncated logarithm is bijective on the commutative nilpotent augmentation ideal and turns multiplicative equation into v=alpha(v)+beta(v). Semisimple C_(p-1) weight decomposition counts r odd with r−1 multiple of ord_p 2, giving dimension s. Independent direct coefficient-vector multiplication yielded p,q=(3,2):8,(3,3):4,(3,5):8,(5,2):12,(5,3):12,(5,5):6,(7,2):16,(7,3):16,(11,2):68.
